2124561296787943647.en_summary: The Kobeissi Letter reports a massive wave of deleveraging in US technology ETFs, with 3x leveraged long Semiconductor ETF $SOXL down 90% from its June peak to lowest since September 2025 (2nd largest drawdown since March 2010 inception), and 3x leveraged long Nasdaq 100 ETF $TQQQ down 53% from June peak to lowest since early April (51% since October 5th), marking a historic liquidation wave in leveraged tech funds.
2124561296787943647.zh_summary: The Kobeissi Letter 報告美國科技 ETF 出現大規模去槓桿浪潮，3 倍槓桿做多半導體 ETF $SOXL 從 6 月高點下跌 90%，至 2025 年 9 月以來最低（2010 年 3 月成立以來第二大回撤），而 3 倍槓桿做多納斯達克 100 ETF $TQQQ 從 6 月高點下跌 53%，至 4 月初以來最低（自 10 月 5 日以來下跌 51%），標誌槓桿科技基金出現歷史性清算浪潮。
